name: @sos-2/ecology
description: SOS 2.0 Package Ecology: the evidence-backed compatibility/conflict graph over the package population (typed COMPATIBLE_WITH/CONFLICTS_WITH edges — evidence-free edges are rejected), composition interaction evidence (synergy/interference recorded about the composition itself — member success never substitutes), and typed decay/obsolescence signals feeding a maturity REVIEW queue that never auto-demotes (Work Order W13; spec/architecture.md §5, §18; docs/package-ecology.md).
